abstract: Germ cell tumors of childhood are tumors arising from germline cells in gonadal or extragonadal locations. Extragonadal germ cell tumors are characteristically located in the midline, arising intracranially or in the mediastinum, retroperitoneum, or pelvis. These tumors are generally easily diagnosed due to typical sites of origin, characteristic imaging findings, and laboratory markers. However, germ cell tumors can be associated with unusual clinical syndromes or imaging features that can perplex the radiologist. This review will illustrate atypical imaging/clinical manifestations and complications of abdominal germ cell tumors in childhood. These features include unusual primary tumors such as multifocal primaries; local complications such as ovarian torsion or ruptured dermoid; atypical presentations of metastatic disease associated with burned-out primary tumor, growing teratoma syndrome, and gliomatosis peritonei; endocrine manifestations such as precocious puberty and hyperthyroidism; and antibody mediated paraneoplastic syndrome such as anti-N-methyl-D-aspartate-receptor antibody-mediated encephalitis. This review aims to illustrate unusual imaging features associated with the primary tumor, metastatic disease, or distant complications of abdominal germ cell tumors of childhood.
abstract_ja: 小児胚細胞腫瘍は性腺または性腺外の位置の胚細胞から生じる腫瘍である。性腺外胚細胞腫瘍は特徴的に正中線に位置し、頭蓋内、縦隔、後腹膜、または骨盤に発生する。これらの腫瘍は発生源の典型的な部位、特徴的な画像所見、および実験室マーカーのために一般的に診断が容易である。しかし胚細胞腫瘍は放射線科医を困惑させる可能性のある異常な臨床症候群または画像特徴に関連することがある。本レビューは小児腹部胚細胞腫瘍の異型画像・臨床症状および合併症を示す。これらの機能には多焦点原発腫瘍などの異常な原発腫瘍、卵巣捻転または破裂類皮嚢腫などの局所合併症、燃え尽きた原発腫瘍、growing teratoma syndrome、および腹膜神経膠腫症に関連する転移性疾患の非定型的な提示、早発思春期と甲状腺機能亢進症などの内分泌症状、および抗NMDA受容体抗体媒介脳炎などの抗体媒介傍腫瘍症候群が含まれる。本レビューは小児腹部胚細胞腫瘍の原発腫瘍、転移性疾患、または遠隔合併症に関連する異常な画像所見を示すことを目的とする。
